counterStrafe.title: Counter-strafe errors
counterStrafe.subtitle: Shots fired while moving (no stop before shooting)

ttk.title: Time to kill
ttk.subtitle: Avg ms from first shot to kill

flash.title: Flash efficiency
flash.subtitle: % of own flashes that blinded an enemy

reload.title: Reload errors
reload.subtitle: Reloads with bullets still in magazine (>5 bullets)
reload.explanation: Reloading with bullets still in the magazine wastes ammo and takes time at a potentially dangerous moment. Ideally, reload only when the magazine is empty or near-empty.

angleControl.title: Angle control
angleControl.subtitle: Positions held ≥2 seconds without movement
angleControl.whenHeading: When in the round this occurs
angleControl.explanation: Angle control counts unique positions held still for ≥2 seconds during live rounds. A higher value means patient angle holding. Phase breakdown shows when in the round you prefer to hold angles.

reaction.title: Reaction time
reaction.subtitle: Avg ms from enemy peek onset to first shot
reaction.summary: {{n}} duels · avg {{avg}} ms · min {{min}} ms · max {{max}} ms
reaction.explanation: Reaction time measures how many ms elapsed from when the enemy started moving (peek onset) until your first shot in the duel. Measured on winning duels where the enemy was in motion. Lower is better.

overshoot.title: Overshoot count
overshoot.subtitle: {{overshoots}} overshoots · {{undershoots}} undershoots · {{clean}} clean (of {{wins}} wins)
overshoot.explanation: Overshoot — your aim crossed past the enemy (angle sign changed). Undershoot — aim never reached the enemy (angle never zeroed). Clean duels — neither.

crosshair.title: Crosshair placement
crosshair.subtitle: {{head}} head hits out of {{total}} first-bullet hits
crosshair.explanation: Measures how accurately you pre-aim at head level before duels start. Calculated as % of first-bullet hits on an enemy that landed on the head. A high value means good pre-aim and snappy flicks.

missedFirst.title: Inaccurate first shot
missedFirst.subtitle: {{missed}} first-bullet misses out of {{total}} won duels
missedFirst.explanation: Inaccurate first shot — the first bullet fired in the duel did no damage. Even when you won, it means you lost the first-bullet advantage. Improve your pre-aim and counter-strafe to reduce this number.

excellent.title: Excellent contacts
excellent.subtitle: Duel wins: stopped at shot + first bullet hit
excellent.explanation: Excellent contacts are duel wins where you were not moving when you first shot (velocity ≤{{velocity}} u/s) and your first bullet hit the enemy. This combines correct movement mechanics with accurate first-shot placement — the most valuable indicator of duel mechanics.

reactionHits.title: Reaction on hits
reactionHits.subtitle: Avg reaction time only in duels where first bullet hit
reactionHits.explanation: Reaction on hits shows your reaction time only in duels where your first bullet hit the enemy. This is a cleaner measure of how fast you react when you are properly aimed — without misses that inflate the overall average. Lower is better.

passiveAngle.title: Passive angle
passiveAngle.subtitle: {{n}} duels — stood still in an exposed position before shooting
passiveAngle.explanation: Passive angle — you were stationary (displacement < 40 units) for several ticks before your first shot from an exposed position. This gives the enemy an easy take — they already know where you are. Use quick peeks or shift position before engaging.
